title: Handover evidence
description: evidence.json in a frozen handover (handovers/<id>/), written by Core.handoverPlan at freeze only when the work item being frozen has an evidence list (work/<id>.yaml), listed and hashed in handover.yaml (named there as `evidence:`). It says what is wrong, in the item's order, and names kinds, keys and counts only, never values from the apps or from Jira. A parity entry holds that step's failing findings from the latest parity report (kind and key; msg only for a shape finding, whose message is built from roles, column names and shapes). A jira entry holds the issue's key, title, type and link and nothing else. An escape entry holds the id. Nothing else of a parity report or an inbox entry is copied. Its hash joins the handover id. designc owns this contract; consumers conform to it. docs/handover-evidence.example.json is the shared fixture.

report.description: recorded: parity/reports/<scenario>.json was readable; missing: it was absent or unreadable.

status.description: That step's status in the report; null when the report or the step is absent.

findings.description: That step's findings with severity fail, in report order.
